selection: Five bounded proposals from33 wider findings/17 paths, not the research ceiling or an implementation assignment. Recheck moving YAIR input hashes before implementation.

packets.title: A material treatment keeps the exact repaired object
packets.player_journey: At the existing Village workshop, inspect one actually owned measured strip or repair component. Choose a coating or reinforcement using actual eligible input, tool/right and willing worker. The retained object gains one purpose-specific quality and is later used on the same drainage/cover project.
packets.costs: Proposed original fees, material, effort and played duration are chosen by integrator; source DF balance is not copied. Preserve reusable tool/container.
packets.mutation_and_consumer: One native item identity carries bounded treatment provenance; existing drainage/cover reader consumes its property. No duplicate item or mirrored inventory.
packets.failure_and_recovery: Unsupported body/right/material pauses or rejects before new spending; interrupted job follows its frozen reservation policy. Treatment cannot be farmed through split/merge or reapply.
packets.gap: Current measured-strip identity exists, but a general bounded purpose-specific item treatment descriptor/consumer needs the integrator.
packets.acceptance: Later permitted playable check must show exact object before/after, useful alternate untreated route, real costs, cancellation, transfer and reload retaining one identity.
packets.save_policy: Preserve current native/state owners and old IDs/frozen meanings; integrator must decide compatible admission/migration. Current gameplay/save tests remain deferred.
packets.scope: Existing base.frontier slice; no new realm/prestige or source-code/art transplant.

packets.title: A small functional injury has specific care and useful work consequences
packets.player_journey: After an explicitly accepted local challenge, receive at most one supported hand wound or exposure with observed cause. Choose supplied dressing, safer rest or paid willing care; a precision task remains blocked or reduced only while the actual condition persists.
packets.costs: Actual care stock, consenting actor effort and shared played time; reversible original intensity/duration.
packets.mutation_and_consumer: Existing condition/cause owner feeds native dexterity/work eligibility. Distinguish cleaned exposure, closed wound and recovered hand use; do not add a second HP drain.
packets.failure_and_recovery: Unsupported/nonliving/alternate bodies do not inherit human treatment. No occult cure of unobserved venom, permanent marks or another actor.
packets.gap: Current cut/listed-venom care exists; the meaningful extension is one explicitly differentiated tissue/faculty recovery state, not another renamed cut action.
packets.acceptance: Later allowed gameplay proof must show cause, observed symptom, a practical alternate task, stock use, treatment-specific partial recovery, expiry and supported-body behavior.
packets.save_policy: Preserve current native/state owners and old IDs/frozen meanings; integrator must decide compatible admission/migration. Current gameplay/save tests remain deferred.
packets.scope: Existing base.frontier slice; no new realm/prestige or source-code/art transplant.

packets.title: A physical workshop record can be copied, entrusted and taught
packets.player_journey: The existing archive/workshop produces one owned field-method record from actual material. Keep it for study, pay a willing reader to make an attributed copy, or entrust the exact record to an eligible apprentice. Later useful work requires learned method and actual body/tool support.
packets.costs: Actual writing material, copy labor/funding, ordinary study time; copying does not itself grant comprehension.
packets.mutation_and_consumer: One native record item retains author/sample/copy provenance. Existing knowledge owner records receipt, study and capable execution separately.
packets.failure_and_recovery: Withheld/lost/loaned original affects access; a received account is not direct witnessing. Unsupported language/body/method leaves knowledge retained and execution unavailable.
packets.gap: Current knowledge/custody/jobs support bounded authored steps; native physical record-copy/writing provenance and instructional completion need a scoped integrator binding.
packets.acceptance: Later playable gate follows one original/copy through custody, actual material expenditure, study, independent learner choice, useful production and reload.
packets.save_policy: Preserve current native/state owners and old IDs/frozen meanings; integrator must decide compatible admission/migration. Current gameplay/save tests remain deferred.
packets.scope: Existing base.frontier slice; no new realm/prestige or source-code/art transplant.

packets.title: Pay for a qualified inventory report that can become stale
packets.player_journey: Ask an existing willing Village worker to count one workshop stock or appraise one sample at an actual desk. A quick estimate and a funded full count differ in precision and time; a later delivery/withdrawal leaves the prior report visibly dated.
packets.costs: Actual worker attention, site access and funds; voluntary refusal/other committed work remain valid.
packets.mutation_and_consumer: Observer-scoped knowledge receipt includes count basis/time/precision and source cause. Planning UI labels the report while durable executor still checks authoritative stock.
packets.failure_and_recovery: A stale estimate never authorizes nonexistent stock; private possessions never appear merely because an NPC is registered. Update requires another real observation.
packets.gap: Existing sample provenance and witnessed views can be reused. A bounded estimate/exact-report definition and stale-report UI need authored content; no second accounting state.
packets.acceptance: Later gate demonstrates estimate, full count, real worker costs/refusal, stock change, stale display and executor refusal on unsupported stock.
packets.save_policy: Preserve current native/state owners and old IDs/frozen meanings; integrator must decide compatible admission/migration. Current gameplay/save tests remain deferred.
packets.scope: Existing base.frontier slice; no new realm/prestige or source-code/art transplant.

packets.title: One settlement change attracts a specific informed danger
packets.player_journey: One completed frontier extraction/storage project changes the local situation. A visible report reveals a finite attracted animal or rival response. Choose quieter production, practical shelter/guard or a negotiated claim, then revisit the changed site.
packets.costs: Actual worker/tool/material/effort or finite trade cost; no daily mandatory upkeep and no automatic refill.
packets.mutation_and_consumer: Existing situation and event/controller owners retain cause, target, observation and aftermath. Habitat/body/exposure facts determine the response.
packets.failure_and_recovery: Retaliation targets an actual informed actor/cause; unknown private work cannot create omniscient hostility. Withdrawal can leave a changed site while preserving separately owned body/stock time policies.
packets.gap: Current finite events/controllers and crop clock exist. One authored ecology/attention threshold with original danger/recovery outcomes needs integrator content, not a universal ecology simulator.
packets.acceptance: Later gate follows real development through known warning, chosen preparation/negotiation, actual costs, failure/withdrawal and a visibly changed return.
packets.save_policy: Preserve current native/state owners and old IDs/frozen meanings; integrator must decide compatible admission/migration. Current gameplay/save tests remain deferred.
packets.scope: Existing base.frontier slice; no new realm/prestige or source-code/art transplant.
